in_hebrew.name: Helgeson
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Helgeson הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old Norse, Helle- (god) + Geir- (spear) + son. Translated as 'God's spear-bearer' or 'God's son'.

in_greek.name: Helgeson
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God's son
in_greek.long_meaning: Helgeson είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old Norse, Helle- (god) + Geir- (spear) + son. Translated as 'God's spear-bearer' or 'God's son'.

in_latin.name: Helgeson
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God's son
in_latin.long_meaning: Helgeson est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Old Norse, Helle- (god) + Geir- (spear) + son. Translated as 'God's spear-bearer' or 'God's son'.
